jobs.detail: UNDERHAND REVERSE-GRIP PULL-UP (CHIN-UP), TWO phases. Whole person FRONT three-quarter view, same GRAY straight fixed overhead pull-up BAR attached to two short gray wall brackets at top corners, faint white wall background, whole BAR/brackets AND feet inside each panel with generous top/bottom margins. BOTH HANDS shoulder-width UNDERHAND SUPINATED grip: palms face TOWARD MODEL FACE, fingers/thumbs wrap bar securely, same grip never changes. LEFT dead hang BOTH elbows fully extended overhead, torso straight, feet together CLEAR OFF FLOOR, legs straight no kick. RIGHT pull body UP until CHIN clearly ABOVE fixed bar, elbows bend down toward ribs, chest approaches bar, torso vertical neutral, feet hang together, no knee swing. Same exact fixed bar HEIGHT/length/anchors, hand positions and camera; only body rises with elbow flexion, no moving bar or arm length change. Primary LATS only smooth diffuse blurred RED tint on intact opaque BLACK side/back shirt over lateral torso BELOW armpits down toward waist; do NOT highlight biceps/deltoids/upper-back primary. No radial fibers/muscle subdivisions/cutaways on shirt. All exposed limbs fine detailed grayscale anatomy. Full opaque shirt/shorts wrap front sides back seat crotch. No text/arrows.
